utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. If Quinn can invite a few more neighbors, that would really help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll ask Quinn to bring a few more neighbors. I’m also checking the time, and Rosa can send me the tools list when it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I appreciate it — please keep me posted on the time and the tools list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the repair-drive supplies and set aside anything we can spare, especially anything useful for the fence board or porch step.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so you’re setting aside the spare tools and parts for the fence board and porch step, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I’ll set aside any spare tools and parts that can help with the fence board or porch step.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m going to check the back shed and porch boxes for anything useful, then bring it all to the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Sam—thank you. I’ll send Leo the tools and parts list, and we’ll compare it with what you find at the hall.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rosa—that’ll help a lot. I’ll bring whatever I find over and we can compare it with Leo’s list at the hall.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m keeping a tidy list: we still need spare parts and a headcount check for the repair drive. Gus has the tools and basics covered, and Rey is checking the cracked step today.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli — I’ve got the parts and headcount noted. Do we have the final time and location confirmed yet?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Not yet, Hana — I’d like to confirm the final time and spot before I write it down. Once that’s set, I’ll add it to my little list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still checking my schedule for that 4:30 shift, and we’ve got Faye helping line up volunteers plus spread the word. Gus is bringing extra tools and supplies and checking Eli’s list, so we’re in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — once Sam brings what’s in the shed and porch boxes, I’ll match it against Rosa’s list so we can see what still needs to come from Leo.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds perfect — once Sam brings those shed and porch boxes, we’ll know what’s left for Leo to track down.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — I’ll spread the word to the other parents and bring a few supplies. Once Faye sends the time and place, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Bo — that helps a lot. We’ve still got the loose fence board on the list, so I’ll keep an eye out for anything that fits.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out too, and I’ll share the time and place as soon as Faye sends it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — do we have the final time and location for the repair drive yet? I can help check on the tools and parts, too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet, but I’m checking while I run errands and I’ll pass along anything I hear. Quinn’s still reaching out today, and Vik should be sharing the plan and task list soon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks — I’ll keep an ear out too and can help confirm the tools and parts once the plan comes through.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we still need more parts or volunteers for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’ve still got a short list: Oren’s loose fence board and Rey’s cracked porch step. I can pass the plan along, and Oren wanted the remaining tasks too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — do we still need more volunteers too, or just those parts?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting out the repair drive timing and what to bring, so I want to be sure before I commit to anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Totally—I'm still pulling together the final time, location, and what tools or parts folks should bring. I’ll start by checking in with the Maple Street people and post the notice at the corner store bulletin board too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I’m still waiting on the final timing and supplies list before I can say for sure what I’ll bring.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like it’s really picking up, which is great. I still need the exact time and place, but I can help spread the word if you need more tools or volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Nell — I’m still asking around about the timing and what supplies they’ll need, and I’ll pass along anything I hear. Quinn’s checking with a few more neighbors today too, so we should know more soon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect — just let me know when you hear the time and place, and I’ll keep an ear out for any tools or spare parts they still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oren still said the cracked step by the porch and that loose fence board need attention. Cleo and Gus are handling supplies and tools, and I’m waiting to hear if anything else turns up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help spread the word to the other parents and check on a few volunteers for 4:30 after pickup. I’ll also ask whether we still need any tools or parts.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d help a lot, thanks. If you hear anything about tools or parts, let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’m still waiting on Leo to lock in the time. If you can bring your tool kit and a few basics, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ll bring my tool kit and some basics for the repair drive. Once Leo confirms the time, I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out for Leo’s update. We’re still on, so I’ll let you know as soon as the time’s set.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane — I’m keeping the repair drive organized for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send Leo the list of tools and parts we still need. Rey is checking that cracked porch step, too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll help confirm the final time and any extra tools or parts we still need. I’m sorry I’m late, but I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane — I’ll confirm the final time, and if you spot any extra tools or parts we need, just send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — I’m on it. I’ll tell the other parents and bring a few supplies, and once Faye sends the time and place, I’ll pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Bo. I’m still checking the time, and Rosa will send the tools and parts list soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll keep folks posted and bring a few supplies. Just send the time and place when Faye has it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my toolbox and some basic supplies for the repair drive. If Eli’s list changes, just let me know and I’ll grab what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, Gus—tools and supplies sound like exactly what they need. I’ll pass along any updates I hear about the time or place.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — thanks, Nell. I’ll keep my toolbox ready and wait for Eli’s update on anything else the drive still needs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m out running errands, but I’ll check what’s still needed for the repair drive and keep an ear out for any updates. Oren’s ready to help, Cleo’s on supplies, and Quinn’s still reaching out today.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. Please keep an eye on the spare parts and the volunteer count, and let me know what’s left for the list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll keep an eye on the spare parts and volunteer count, and I’ll let you know what’s left for the list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So just to confirm, the drive still needs tools, spare parts, and a few hands to help out, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, that’s right — I’ll check on a few volunteers and confirm whether any tools or parts are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just making sure — Sam’s the one starting with what needs fixing first, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the repair-drive supplies and set aside anything we can spare, especially anything useful for the fence board or porch step.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps. I’m still sorting out the timing and what to bring, so please let me know once the list and schedule are set.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and let you know as soon as the list and schedule are settled.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. If you can, please ask Quinn to invite a few more neighbors to help out too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can do that — I’ll ask Quinn to invite a few more neighbors and let them know we could use extra hands today.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I appreciate you handling that and checking for supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m spreading the word right away and I’ll invite a few more neighbors today. I’ll let Uli know who can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — I’ll compare Rosa’s list with what Sam brings in, then I’ll see what still needs to come from Leo. If you hear back from Uli, send me the update.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll pass along any update from Uli as soon as I hear back, and I’m still reaching out to a few more neighbors today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We still need spare parts and more volunteers. Ira’s checking the list, but I’m trying to pin down exactly what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m on it — I’ll check the last time, place, and any needed tools or parts, then I’ll reach out to the Maple Street folks and post the notice at the corner store.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good — can you tell me once you’ve got the final list? Then I can see if we still need to ask for more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m going to check my schedule and see if I can sign up for a 4:30 shift after pickup. That timing still feels like the right plan for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds great, Mara — 4:30 after pickup still seems like the best fit. I’m still asking around about the timing and what supplies to bring, and I’ll pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate you asking around. I’ll check my schedule and let you know if I can take the 4:30 shift.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds like we’ve got a good handle on it. Let me know if anything else turns up on Eli’s list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’m still waiting on Leo to lock in the time. Once that’s set, we’ll know what to bring for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Right, once Leo confirms the time, we can match it up with what Gus and the rest are bringing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren — I’m still checking the time, location, and whether we need any extra tools or parts before we lock in the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thanks — I’m still keeping an eye on the loose fence board for the repair drive. If Vik sends the list, I’ll follow along and help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren — I’ll wait for Vik’s list, and once we have the time, location, and any needed tools or parts confirmed, we can lock it in.
